description: This is a PHP class file defining 'ProspectListFormBase', a base form handler for managing Prospect Lists in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for generating HTML forms, handling form submissions, and managing access control within the application.

classes.name: ProspectListFormBase
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to generate, display, and handle prospect list forms within SuiteCRM, including access checks, form rendering, and save operations.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates HTML form for creating or editing a prospect list, including form headers, hidden inputs, and submit button.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Constructs the core body of the form, including input fields for prospect list name and type, along with JavaScript validation.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission, saving the prospect list record if permissions and required fields are satisfied, and handles redirection after save.
